in_marathi.name: Saravanakumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War, Auspicious One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saravanakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Saravanakumar is a combination of two words: Saravan and Kumar. Saravan means 'God of War' in Tamil. Kumar is a common title for young boys in Hindu culture, which means 'younger brother of God'. Together, Saravanakumar means 'Auspicious One, God of War'.

Saravan means 'God of War' in Tamil. Kumar is a common title for young boys in Hindu culture, which means 'younger brother of God'. Together, Saravanakumar means 'Auspicious One, God of War'.
